items.note: 319x overuse vs humans (IsGPT). AI significance-anchor applied to any positive outcome.
items.example: Her persistence is a testament to the human spirit.

items.note: tapestry is the single most overused AI metaphor noun (35x per arXiv, 227x per IsGPT). Phrase form is nearly always AI.
items.example: The city offers a rich tapestry of cultures and traditions.

items.note: Metaphorical use of 'tapestry' for any complex collection. Extremely rare in pre-AI prose at this frequency.
items.example: Their history is a tapestry of triumph and tragedy.

items.note: Confirmed 319x overuse (IsGPT). Formulaic significance phrase.
items.example: The campaign left an indelible mark on the industry.

items.note: Confirmed 902x overuse vs humans (IsGPT). Meta-label that replaces actual content.
items.example: This report will provide valuable insights into consumer behavior.

items.note: Confirmed 739x overuse (IsGPT). Hollow outcome promise.
items.example: Attendees will gain valuable insights from the panel discussion.

items.note: Confirmed 298x overuse (IsGPT). Third form of the same AI formula.
items.example: The study offers valuable insights for practitioners.

items.note: Confirmed 131x overuse (IsGPT). Vague depth claim with no specifics.
items.example: Read on to gain a deeper understanding of the subject.

items.note: Confirmed 355x overuse (IsGPT). Scope-claiming formula that substitutes for actual content.
items.example: This guide will help you gain a comprehensive understanding of the topic.

items.note: Confirmed 206x overuse (IsGPT). Generic forward-looking phrase applied to any development.
items.example: This discovery opens new avenues for research.

items.note: 10x overuse; near-cliche even outside AI. FP risk: medium because journalists and academics use it legitimately.
items.example: The findings shed light on the root causes of the problem.

items.note: Same as 'shed light on'; present-tense form equally flagged. Study sheds light on: 130x overuse (IsGPT).
items.example: The analysis sheds light on long-ignored disparities.

items.note: 17x overuse (research corpus). AI extends engineering metaphor to any abstract noun.
items.example: Organizations must harness the power of data to stay competitive.

items.note: 16x overuse. Compound that signals difficulty without specifying what's difficult.
items.example: Businesses must navigate the complexities of modern regulation.

items.note: 15x overuse. Metaphorical unlock applied to any capability or resource.
items.example: This approach can unlock the potential of your workforce.

items.note: AI significance-anchor; beacon applied to any positive example. Not in cliches.json (stands as a testament to is there).
items.example: The organization stands as a beacon of innovation in the sector.

items.note: Abstraction-stacking formula: 'at the intersection of X and Y lies Z'. Overused in thought-leadership writing.
items.example: We operate at the intersection of technology and human experience.

items.note: Template: '[X] has the power to transform [large abstract noun]'. Applied to routine developments.
items.example: This tool has the power to transform how we work.

items.note: Pseudo-profound inflection-point formula. Near-absent in human writing at this frequency.
items.example: We stand at a crossroads that will define the next decade.

items.note: Significance inflation applied to routine events. Compound with 'pivotal' (16x overuse adjective).
items.example: We find ourselves at a pivotal moment in the history of computing.

items.note: Hyperbolic claim applied to incremental developments. Low FP: human writers use it far less mechanically.
items.example: Artificial intelligence changes everything about how we approach this problem.

items.text: the stakes have never been higher
items.note: Escalation formula; AI applies to mundane topics. Rarely appears in human writing without irony.
items.example: As deadlines approach, the stakes have never been higher.

items.note: 20x overuse. Foster applied to innovation specifically is the most common AI corporate-motivation compound.
items.example: Leaders must create environments that foster innovation.

items.note: 18x overuse. FP risk medium because it appears in genuine product copy too.
items.example: Our mission is to drive innovation across all sectors.

items.note: 18x overuse. Generic marketing formula for any audience-interaction goal.
items.example: Brands need fresh content strategies to drive engagement.

items.note: 13x overuse. Generic agency formula applied universally regardless of actual empowerment.
items.example: The platform is designed to empower individuals to take control of their finances.

items.note: 12x overuse. Applied to any content without specifying how or why it resonates.
items.example: The message was crafted to resonate with audiences across all demographics.

items.note: AI significance phrase for asserting authenticity or tradition without evidence.
items.example: Their approach is deeply rooted in decades of research.

items.note: AI transition phrase implying significance for the next development. Overused as a section bridge.
items.example: These changes are setting the stage for a major transformation.

items.note: Significance inflation; AI applies to any notable development, stripping the phrase of force.
items.example: The decision marked a watershed moment for the industry.

items.note: Similar to watershed moment; AI uses as section-closer significance claim.
items.example: This partnership represents a turning point in the company's trajectory.

items.note: Overused revolution claim applied to incremental improvements.
items.example: Smartphones have revolutionized the way we communicate.

items.note: Double AI signal: 'transformed' + 'landscape of'. Compound that almost never appears in human writing.
items.example: Social media has transformed the landscape of modern journalism.

items.note: Temporal hedge AI uses for speculative forecasts without committing to a timeframe.
items.example: In the not-too-distant future, this technology will be ubiquitous.

items.note: Generic future-closer transition. 'Moving forward' is in prohibited-phrases; this variant is not in cliches.
items.example: As we move forward, collaboration will be essential.

items.note: Stock narrative closer; appears in EQBench slop trigrams. Near-formulaic in AI fiction and motivational copy.
items.example: Together, they were ready to face whatever challenges lay ahead.

items.text: life would never be the same
items.note: Stock narrative closer from antislop-sampler slop trigrams. Signals AI-generated story endings.
items.example: After that day, life would never be the same.

items.note: Stock narrative / marketing closer implying momentum without specifics.
items.example: The team was ready; they were only just getting started.

items.note: Stock fiction closer from antislop-sampler. Signals AI-generated story resolution.
items.example: No matter what came next, they would face it together.

items.note: Stock narrative closer / motivational phrase from antislop-sampler slop trigrams.
items.example: She walked away with a renewed sense of purpose.

items.note: Variant of renewed sense of purpose; both appear in EQBench slop trigrams.
items.example: The experience gave him a newfound sense of purpose.

items.note: Academic significance inflation without specifying which contributions or which field.
items.example: Her work represents significant contributions to the field of cognitive science.

items.note: 22x more frequent in AI text. Formal metaphor substituting for a plain noun like 'in' or 'within'.
items.example: In the realm of digital marketing, content is king.

items.note: AI applies indiscriminately as metaphor for any collection of useful things.
items.example: The archives are a treasure trove of historical documents.

items.note: AI's most frequent beacon compound. Applied to any example of resilience or positivity.
items.example: The clinic serves as a beacon of hope for the community.

items.note: Abstract visual metaphor AI cycles through as a tapestry variant.
items.example: The neighborhood is a mosaic of cultures and traditions.

items.note: 'The fabric of society/democracy/community' is an AI-favored abstract metaphor. FP risk: medium in literary contexts.
items.example: These values are woven into the fabric of our culture.

items.note: Specific compound flagged by Wikipedia Signs of AI Writing as significance pile-up phrase.
items.example: Each artist is contributing to the fabric of our collective identity.

items.note: AI uses as a vague depth signal. FP risk medium: legitimate in philosophy, low in marketing/SEO.
items.example: This product captures the essence of modern living.

items.note: False-depth framing; AI uses to assert profundity before a simple statement.
items.example: At its core, the problem is about trust.

items.note: Travel-brochure compound with two AI tell words: 'nestled' and 'heart of'. Almost exclusively AI-generated.
items.example: The boutique hotel is nestled in the heart of the old city.

items.note: 'Vibrant' is a flagged AI adjective; 'hub of' is a generic descriptor. The compound is tourism-brochure slop.
items.example: The district has become a vibrant hub of creative energy.

items.note: Combines two AI signals: 'thriving' and 'ecosystem of'. Applied to any community or platform.
items.example: The city has built a thriving ecosystem of startups.

items.note: Combines 'rich', 'cultural', and 'tapestry' - three high-frequency AI descriptors in one phrase.
items.example: The festival celebrates the region's rich cultural tapestry.

items.note: Generic engagement imperative in travel, marketing, and self-help AI copy.
items.example: Immerse yourself in the local culture for a truly authentic experience.

items.note: Generic discovery frame; AI applies to any topic regardless of actual wonder.
items.example: Discover the wonders of sustainable living in this guide.

items.note: Universal-appeal filler; signals AI has nothing specific to say about the audience.
items.example: The new platform has something for everyone, from beginners to experts.

items.note: Hedge that forestalls a real answer. Near-absent in pre-AI writing.
items.example: There is no one-size-fits-all answer when it comes to leadership styles.

items.note: Self-help AI compound combining two flagged terms: 'embrace' (generic directive) + 'journey' (process metaphor).
items.example: Instead of focusing on the outcome, learn to embrace the journey.

items.note: Intensified variant of 'unlock your potential'. Near-canonical AI motivational phrase.
items.example: This program will help you unlock your true potential.

items.note: Generic outcome promise in self-help and marketing copy. Transformation applied to any change.
items.example: Five habits that will transform your life starting today.

items.text: step out of your comfort zone
items.note: Near-universal AI self-help phrase. FP risk: medium because humans use it too, but at far lower density.
items.example: Growth happens when you step out of your comfort zone.

items.note: Philosophical platitude used in AI motivational content as fake wisdom.
items.example: She reminded herself that everything happens for a reason.

items.note: AI depth-claim formula: '[X] is more than just [Y]'. Very high FP risk individually; signal is the full template pattern.
items.example: This is more than just a software update - it's a paradigm shift.

items.note: Confirmed in common-cliche dictionaries as missing from cliches.json. AI uses as a fatalistic closer.
items.example: We tried to fix it but at this point it is what it is.

items.note: Standard English cliche confirmed missing from cliches.json in other-catalogs.md research.
items.example: The new hire was a diamond in the rough with enormous untapped potential.

items.note: Common cliche confirmed potentially missing from cliches.json.
items.example: After the funding fell through, the project was hanging by a thread.

items.note: Confirmed potentially missing; common in AI-generated investigative or thorough-process claims.
items.example: Our team will leave no stone unturned in our search for answers.

items.note: Confirmed potentially missing from cliches.json per other-catalogs.md.
items.example: Losing that contract was a blessing in disguise for the firm.

items.note: Documented fiction formula from antislop-sampler slop trigrams. Near-absent in pre-AI fiction.
items.example: She answered, her voice barely above a whisper.

items.note: Confirmed slop trigram from antislop-sampler. Somatic cliche AI uses for emotional states.
items.example: He reached for the door, heart pounding in his chest.

items.note: Slop trigram from antislop-sampler. AI uses as a beat to mark emotional transitions.
items.example: She took a deep breath before stepping onto the stage.

items.note: Confirmed slop trigram. AI deploys this to show thinking without describing the thought.
items.example: He sat at the desk, brow furrowed in concentration.

items.note: Confirmed slop trigram from antislop-sampler. Somatic reaction cliche.
items.example: When she saw him, her breath caught in her throat.

items.note: Confirmed slop trigram. AI uses as a dramatic beat marker between scenes.
items.example: When she stood to speak, the room fell silent.

items.note: Slop trigram from antislop-sampler. AI atmospheric description applied in any indoor setting.
items.example: In the afternoon light, dust motes danced through the air.

items.note: Slop trigram; common enough in older human writing too but overrepresented in AI fiction.
items.example: When he smiled at her, her heart skipped a beat.

items.note: Slop trigram variant: 'air thick with tension/anticipation/scent'. AI atmosphere cliche.
items.example: They sat across the table, the air thick with tension.

items.note: Slop trigram from antislop-sampler. Signals AI's shortcut for depicting mental activity.
items.example: She lay awake, her mind racing with possibilities.

items.note: Slop trigram from antislop-sampler. AI pause/beat formula in dialogue.
items.example: His accusation hung in the air between them.

items.note: Slop trigram from antislop-sampler. Near-formulaic AI facial-expression cliche.
items.example: He watched her struggle with the puzzle, a smile playing on his lips.

items.note: Slop trigram from antislop-sampler. AI time-compression formula in narrative.
items.example: They waited, and days turned to weeks without a response.

items.note: AI travel and promotional writing formula: 'nestled in the heart of', 'situated in the heart of'. FP medium: used by humans too but overrepresented.
items.example: The studio is located in the heart of the creative district.

items.note: Among top-45 AI phrases. 'Plays a crucial/vital/key role' is flagged across multiple AI detection sources.
items.example: Technology will play a crucial role in addressing climate change.

items.note: Synonym-cycling variant of 'plays a crucial role'. Flagged in NIH study as high-increase academic phrase.
items.example: Sleep plays a vital role in cognitive performance.

items.text: plays a pivotal role in shaping
items.note: 182x overuse (GPTZero). The most extreme compound variant of the 'plays a [adj] role' pattern.
items.example: This legislation plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of education.

items.note: #14 on common AI phrases list. Applied to mundane points; asserts importance without arguing it.
items.example: The importance of early intervention cannot be overstated.

items.note: 14x more frequent in AI text. Paradoxically says the thing it claims doesn't need saying.
items.example: It goes without saying that customer satisfaction is our top priority.
